blocks.text: Bohr model ek yak-jehti (one-dimensional) model tha jo atom mein electrons ki taqseem bayan karne ke liye ek quantum number istemal karta tha; wahid aham maloomat orbit ka size aur energy thi, jo quantum number n se bayan hoti thi. Schrodinger ka model electron ko seh-jehti (three-dimensional) jagah mein rehne deta hai, to use un orbitals ko bayan karne ke liye teen coordinates, teen quantum numbers, chahiyein jin mein electrons mil sakte hain. Schrodinger ke wave equations se aane wale teen quantum numbers principal (n), angular (l) aur magnetic (m) quantum numbers hain, jo atom mein orbitals ka size, shakal aur khala mein rukh (orientation) bayan karte hain. Chautha, spin quantum number, un do electrons mein farq karta hai jo ek orbital mein reh sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: siyah nucleus ke gird chaar ek doosre ke andar daire K, L, M aur N, apne subshells aur electron gunjaish 2, 8, 18 aur 32 ke saath. Daen: chaar quantum numbers ki tareefein, oopar aur neeche teer wale do ghoomte electron ke khaake, aur shells, n, l ki qeematon, subshells, orbitals ki tadaad aur electrons ki table.
blocks.caption: Shells, subshells, orbitals aur chaar quantum numbers (Tables 2.3 se 2.5 aur spin figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Principal quantum number n shell, us ka size aur energy, aur us ki gunjaish 2n squared muqarrar karta hai. Azimuthal number l, 0 se n manfi 1 tak, subshell aur us ki shakal muqarrar karta hai: s kurrawi (spherical), p dumb-bell, d clover leaf, f pecheeda, jo 2(2l + 1) electrons rakhta hai. Magnetic number m, manfi l se musbat l tak, 2l + 1 rukh deta hai, to s mein ek orbital, p mein teen, d mein paanch aur f mein saat, sab ek subshell mein degenerate. Spin number s +1/2 ya -1/2 hai, aur ek orbital do electrons sirf tab rakhta hai jab un ke spin ulte hon. nth shell mein n subshells, n squared orbitals aur 2n squared electrons hain.

blocks.prompt: Batayein ke chaar quantum numbers mein se har ek electron ke bare mein kya batata hai, aur kaun se teen orbital bayan karte hain.
blocks.explanation: n shell deta hai, to orbital ka size aur energy; l subshell aur yun orbital ki shakal; m orbital ka khala mein rukh; s electron ka spin, oopar ya neeche. Pehle teen orbital bayan karte hain; chautha un do electrons mein farq karta hai jo us mein reh sakte hain.

items: Bohr ne ek quantum number istemal kiya; Schrodinger ke seh-jehti orbitals ko teen chahiyein (n size aur energy, l shakal, m rukh) aur electron ke liye spin number s.
